{{Top}} {{Species |image=[[File:Noti-AG.png]] |name=Noti |designation=[[Sentience|Sentient]]{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}} |class= |subspecies= |races= |height=90 [[Centimeter|cm]] {{C|2 [[Foot|ft]] 11 [[List of measurement units#Length|in]]}}''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor=[[Color|Blue]] |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor= |distinctions=*[[Eye]]stalks *Rock-like shells |lifespan= |origin=[[Peridea]] |habitat=[[Grass]]lands |diet= |language=[[Noti language]] }} {{Quote|They're peaceful people.|Ezra Bridger|{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}}} The '''Noti''' were an [[extragalactic]], [[Sentience|sentient]], [[crustacean]]-like [[species]] native to the [[planet]] [[Peridea]], a ringed planet located in the [[far galaxy]], far away from the main [[the galaxy|galaxy]]. ==Biology and appearance== Standing at only 90 [[Centimeter|cm]] (2 [[Foot|ft]] 11 [[List of measurement units#Length|in]]) tall, the Noti had grayish-[[Color|blue]] carapaces (shells) on their backs, similar to a [[Hermit crab|crab]] or other [[Shellfish|shell-forming crustacean]]; in a manner similar to [[turtle]]s, the Noti were capable of retracting into their carapace at-will, normally when threatened. Compared to non-sentient crustaceans, the Noti differed primarily due to the fact that they were a bipedal, terrestrial species; the Noti stood on three-toed, stocky feet and had prominent, strong hands resembling pincers or claws, each equipped with two to three digits. Over their bodies was a bluish skin which extended to their tubular [[eye]]stalks. Noti typically dressed in simple, rugged clothing beneath their carapi, and did not appear to wear shoes, ==Society and culture== {{Quote|Peaceful, fine. You didn't mention defenseless.''"
''"They've survived well enough.|Sabine Wren and Ezra Bridger describe the Noti|{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}}} The Noti lived in a simple nomadic society on Peridea. They resided in [[Noti's Pod Mobile House|pod-shaped homes]] that alternatively served as modes of transportation, allowing them to travel the planet's grasslands. These homes could be sealed to provide the Noti with cover and protection, much like the shells on their backs. The Noti were a peaceful species, lacking standard [[weapon]]s and instead opting for more primitive methods of defense such as [[slingshot]]s. ==History== {{Quote|Wupa! Wupa!|Ezra Bridger, rallying the Noti during a chase on Peridea|}} After the [[human]] [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] was self-[[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] out of [[the galaxy]], he became stranded on Peridea, where he assimilated into a nomadic village of Noti. [[Little Noti|One member]] of the species was encountered by [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] during the [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|search for Ezra]], and—alongside several other Noti hiding nearby—led Wren to their village and, in turn, Bridger. [[File:Noti-Travelling.png|thumb|300px|Bridger and Wren traveled with the Noti in their mobile pods.]] Bridger traveled with the Noti villagers in their mobile pod-shaped homes to avoid detection from [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and his remaining [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces, whom Bridger had also driven into exile on Peridea. After Bridger and Wren were reunited, they and the Noti traveled the planet until they were [[Mission on Peridea|ambushed]] by [[Shin Hati]] and a [[Bandits of Peridea|group of bandits]]. The Noti assisted Bridger and Wren by using slingshots, and by throwing various objects at the bandits. Although the bandits were able to damage and immobilize one of the mobile homes, Bridger and the remaining Noti circled back to protect their fellow villagers. [[Night Trooper]]s were also deployed to assist Hati, and the Noti then hid inside their pods at the request of Bridger until the attackers retreated. Following the Imperial retreat, Bridger introduced the Noti to his old ally [[Ahsoka Tano]] and the Jedi [[architect droid]] [[Huyang]]. Bridger and his extragalactic friends accompanied the Noti caravan as they travelled through the plains of Peridea with Huyang flying Tano's [[T-6 shuttle]] above them. During their journey, the caravan were attack by two of Thrawn's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]. Though the Jedi took out Thrawn's fighters, several Noti were injured.{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} The Jedi then launched an attack against the [[Great Mothers' Fortress]] but failed to prevent Thrawn's [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]'' from escaping back to the [[the galaxy|New Republic's galaxy]] aboard the ''[[Eye of Sion]]''. While Bridger managed to stow aboard the ''Chimaera'' Wren, Tano and Huyang were stranded on Peridea. They opted to return to the Noti caravan. {{Species-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The Noti first appeared in "[[Part Six: Far, Far Away]]," the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', which was released on [[September 19]], [[2023]]. ==Appearances== *{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}} {{1st}} *{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}} *{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-6-far-far-away-highlights|text=''Ahsoka'' Analyzed: 5 Highlights from "Part Six: Far, Far Away"}} *{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-part-6-far-far-away-extras|text=''Ahsoka'' Extras: "Part Six: Far, Far Away"}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|noti|Noti}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Noti |es=Noti |fr=Noti |ja=ノティ |ka=ნოტები |pl=Noti }} [[Category:Far galaxy sentient species]] [[Category:Sentient species]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Noti]] }}
